skill.name: huawei-cloud-modelarts-skill
skill.description: Manage Huawei Cloud ModelArts resources, training jobs, models, services, and notebooks from AI assistant workflows.
skill.summary: Run common Huawei Cloud ModelArts resource and job management actions.
skill.author: modelarts-agent

security_audit.summary: I reviewed all five static findings and found no confirmed security issue. The URLs are documentation install links, the shell script only prints initialization status, and the secret-key strings are used for redaction. No prompt injection or hidden malicious intent was found in the reviewed files.

static_findings.pattern: [HEURISTIC] High file entropy (6.71 bits) - possible binary/encrypted content

finding_verdicts.reason: README.md line 31 is a documentation-only git clone URL for the public source repository. It is not runtime network access or data exfiltration.
README.md line 99 shows an optional Huawei Cloud PyPI mirror for dependency installation. It is an install instruction, not hidden runtime communication or credential transfer.
scripts/init.sh is a short initialization script that sets shell strict mode and prints status messages. It accepts no input and runs no external commands.
tools/security.py line 17 lists sensitive field names for redaction. The code masks those values instead of reading, storing, or exporting secrets.
README.md is readable Markdown documentation with Chinese text and standard command examples. I found no binary, encrypted, or obfuscated payload content.

content.value_statement: ModelArts teams need fast checks and operations across training jobs, models, services, and notebooks. This skill provides action templates for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
actual_capabilities: Lists OBS bucket counts for a resource overview.
Lists ModelArts training jobs with configurable limits.
Creates a ModelArts training job from a code directory and boot file.
Lists registered ModelArts models and inference services.
Lists ModelArts notebooks and redacts sensitive response fields.
limitations: Requires a ModelArts runtime with valid temporary credentials.
Does not validate cloud quotas, billing impact, or region policy.
Does not manage datasets, OBS objects, or endpoint scaling settings directly.
Error responses are brief and may need platform logs for diagnosis.

use_cases.title: Monitor AI workspace resources
use_cases.description: Check ModelArts jobs, notebooks, models, and inference services before daily operations.

use_cases.title: Submit a training job
use_cases.description: Create a ModelArts training job from a prepared code directory and boot file.

use_cases.title: Review shared platform usage
use_cases.description: Summarize active resources and service counts for operational follow-up.

prompt_templates.title: Show resource overview
prompt_templates.prompt: Show a ModelArts resource overview for my current runtime. Include OBS bucket count and summarize the result.

prompt_templates.title: List recent training jobs
prompt_templates.prompt: List the latest five ModelArts training jobs. Redact sensitive fields and summarize job status.

prompt_templates.title: Create a training job
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a ModelArts training job named {job_name} using code directory {code_dir}, boot file {boot_file}, and flavor {flavor}.

prompt_templates.title: Audit workspace activity
prompt_templates.prompt: List notebooks, models, and inference services. Group results by type and flag resources that need follow-up.

output_examples.input: List my ModelArts training jobs with a limit of five.
output_examples.output: A concise summary of recent training jobs, with sensitive values hidden and failed status highlighted for review.

output_examples.input: Create a training job for my project code.
output_examples.output: A confirmation that the job request was submitted, plus the selected job name, boot file, and flavor.
A summary of active notebooks and inference services, grouped by resource type and status.

best_practices: Use temporary ModelArts runtime credentials and rotate long-lived keys outside the skill.
Confirm training job parameters before creation because jobs can consume paid resources.
Keep limit values small when listing large workspaces.
anti_patterns: Do not paste AK/SK values into prompts or shared logs.
Do not run create actions against production projects without approval.
Do not rely on the skill as the only source for billing or quota checks.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does the skill store credentials?
faq.answer: The reviewed code uses ModelArts Session() and states temporary credential use. Users should still avoid pasting secrets.

faq.question: Can it create cloud resources?
faq.answer: Yes. The create training job action can submit a ModelArts training job.

faq.question: Does it deploy inference services?
faq.answer: It lists inference services. The reviewed actions do not create or scale services.

faq.question: What dependency is required?
faq.answer: The package requires modelarts-sdk version 4.0.0 or newer.

faq.question: Does it work outside Huawei Cloud?
faq.answer: It needs ModelArts SDK access and valid Huawei Cloud runtime credentials.
